rules: Treat teacher-live repo files as user-owned state; preserve content unless the current task explicitly changes it.
Use contracts/course_file_structure.json to place new/changed files.
Never return a whole Physics repository for a routine repair/upgrade.
Exactly one changed/new repo file -> return that single file.
Two or more changed/new repo files -> return one ZIP containing only changed/new files with repository-relative folder structure.
Framework/source diagnostic files are not placed in the live repo unless the resource contract explicitly requires them.
Teacher dashboard is an integration target; if a path/resource addition requires a dashboard change, include the changed dashboard in the repo patch.
